title: Verbs and collocations at work
description: Verbi e collocazioni del lavoro tech/finance

cards.example: We'll roll out the new onboarding flow to production on Tuesday.
We rolled back the release after the error rate spiked.
If the vendor doesn't reply by noon, I'll escalate it.
Let's push back the decision until we have the cost figures.
We pushed back on the deadline because testing wasn't complete.

cards.back: sign off (sth) / sign (sth) off (BrE); sign off on (AmE)
cards.example: The compliance team signed the new onboarding flow off yesterday.
I'll follow up with the partner bank about the missing file.
We're looking into why some orders stayed pending.
We still need to figure out why the job times out.
Can you sort out the access rights for the new developer?
I'll set up a test environment for the vendor by Friday.

cards.back: carry out (a test, an audit, a review)
cards.example: The auditors will carry out a penetration test next month.
Please run the tests again after rebasing your branch.
I'd like to raise a concern about the data retention policy.
The next release addresses the reconciliation mismatch.
We can meet the deadline if we reduce the scope.
We missed the deadline because of the certificate problem.

cards.back: make a decision ('take a decision' is more formal BrE)
cards.example: We need to make a decision on the cloud region today.
We need to take regulatory requirements into account.
I'll hand over the incident to the night shift at eight.
Can you take over the payment integration while I'm away?
Let's catch up tomorrow on the migration plan.
Can we bring the review forward to Wednesday?
We had to put off the go-live until next quarter.
The workshop has been called off due to the outage.
The new reporting module will go live next Monday.
We shipped the digital signature feature ahead of schedule.
We're phasing out the legacy batch jobs this year.

cards.back: scale up (bigger machines) / scale out (more nodes)
cards.example: We scaled out the order service to handle the peak.
I spent the morning troubleshooting the login failures.
We patched the vulnerability within twenty-four hours.
We reconcile our positions with the partner bank every morning.
We onboarded two hundred new clients last month.
The gateway routes orders to the fund platform in real time.
We must comply with GDPR when we process client data.

cards.back: keep someone posted / in the loop
cards.example: I'll keep you posted on the vendor's response.
We weighed up the options before choosing the managed database.

cards.back: come up with (an idea, a solution)
cards.example: The team came up with a simpler retry strategy.
We need to allocate two developers to the reconciliation work.
Let's prioritise the regulatory fixes over new features.
